articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin slides as stocks slump on Iran war expansion, AI spending concern
articles.snippet: Google parent Alphabet beat on revenue but raised its AI spending forecast again, sending its shares sharply lower.

articles.title: Tesla holds bitcoin treasury steady, reports $112M impairment loss
articles.snippet: The electric vehicle maker maintained its 11,509 BTC treasury through the second quarter as bitcoin declined 14%, alongside mixed earnings that beat revenue expectations but missed on profit.
